name: Double pendulum
description: Exploring chaotic motion with a simulation built from Lagrangian equations of motion.

sections.title: What it does
sections.text: Simulates and visualizes a double pendulum, with energy tracking to check numerical accuracy.

sections.title: Implementation
sections.text: The project includes RK4, RK45, and DOP853 integration, plus tools for examining how nearby initial conditions evolve.

sections.title: Testing & analysis
sections.text: Energy tracking, Lyapunov estimates, and Poincaré sections connect the animated motion to numerical checks. The repository includes reproducible configurations and tests.

name: lattice
description: An automatic differentiation engine, built from the ground up to understand how gradients flow.

sections.title: What it does
sections.text: Builds reverse-mode automatic differentiation from scalar values through tensors and neural-network components.

sections.title: Implementation
sections.text: Includes SGD and Adam optimizers and an MNIST multilayer perceptron example. The tensor core is being ported to C++17 with shared-storage views.

sections.title: Testing
sections.text: Gradients are checked against finite differences and PyTorch.
